title: centaurea seridis subsp. maritima
intro: Centaurea seridis subsp. maritima, commonly known as a type of bitter weed or sea centaury, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of colds and flu. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea seridis subsp. maritima include its ability to stimulate the appetite, relieve nausea, and act as a diuretic, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
